appName: Squad Run VR - Fun Running Game
displayName: Squad Run VR - Fun Running Game
display_name: Squad Run VR - Fun Running Game
display_long_description:
Get ready for non-stop action in Squad Run VR – Fun Running Game, an exciting virtual reality runner where speed, timing, and smart choices decide your victory.

Start your run alone and quickly grow your squad by passing through multiplier gates, collecting teammates, and avoiding dangerous traps. Every level pushes your reflexes as you guide your crowd through fast-changing environments filled with moving obstacles, risky paths, and intense moments.

Built exclusively for VR, the game delivers immersive running mechanics, satisfying squad growth, and smooth performance designed for comfortable and fun gameplay sessions.

Challenge yourself to build the biggest crowd, reach the finish line, and achieve new high scores in this addictive running experience.

Perfect for players who enjoy fast gameplay, quick reactions, and rewarding progression.

⭐ Game Features

Immersive VR running and squad-building gameplay

Grow your crowd through smart gate choices

Dodge traps, moving barriers, and tricky obstacles

Fast levels designed for quick and fun play sessions

Smooth controls and optimized VR performance

Increasing difficulty with rewarding progression

Bright environments and satisfying crowd effects

Run smart. Grow fast. Lead your squad to victory.

The bigger your squad, the higher your score.
